firstPlayerRule: The rulebook doesn’t say which team goes first, so agree on a starting team. The team that goes first starts at 0 points and the other team starts at 1 point.
clarifications: After forming two teams, each team decides who will be its Psychic for the first round.
Teams then alternate rounds with a new Psychic each time. If the Psychic’s team scores 4 points and is still behind, it immediately takes another turn with a different Psychic.
In cooperative mode everyone plays as one team.
